in_hebrew.name: קוילן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who is like a young wolf, possibly a warrior or leader. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Κοιλλάν
in_greek.long_meaning: Originally meant ‘interior,’ but later came to mean ‘wailing, lamentation, or inner turmoil.’ This name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Quillanus
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘quillus,’ meaning ‘quill, feather.’ This name is not found in the Bible.
